# Pull Request

Use this template for governed draft-plan and implementation PRs.

Required baseline:

- keep every section below
- add sections if needed for extra evidence or explanation
- do not remove baseline template sections

## ExecPlan

- ExecPlan id:
- Branch role:
- Source branch:

## Purpose

Describe the objective of the PR in 2-5 sentences.

## Scope

- summarize the bounded change set
- list any intentionally excluded work

## Self Review

- what was reviewed by the author before opening the PR
- what was updated after self-review
- what remains intentionally deferred

## Validation

- commands run
- expected status
- notable blockers or deferred checks

## Handoff

- state whether this PR is:
  - draft-plan review only
  - implementation ready after merge
  - implementation follow-up required after merge
- record any graph, queue, or finalization follow-up expected after merge
